'''Firstsource Solutions Limited''' is an Indian [[business process management]] company headquartered in [[Mumbai]]. It is owned by [[RPSG Group|RP-Sanjiv Goenka Group]],<ref name="sr">{{cite web |title=Firstsource Investor Relations - Share Information |url=https://www.firstsource.com/investor-relations/ |publisher=Firstsource.com |access-date=31 August 2019 |archive-date=26 August 2019 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190826160753/http://www.firstsource.com/investor-relations/ |url-status=live }}</ref>  and listed on the [[Bombay Stock Exchange|BSE]] and [[National Stock Exchange of India|NSE]] since 2007.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Firstsource Solutions Annual Report 2020-21 |url=https://www.firstsource.com/Firstsource_AnnualReport_2020-21/mobile/index.html |access-date=2022-03-17 |website=www.firstsource.com |language=en |archive-date=27 September 2021 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210927222834/https://www.firstsource.com/Firstsource_AnnualReport_2020-21/mobile/index.html |url-status=live }}</ref>

== History ==
Firstsource started its operations in 2001 as ICICI InfoTech Upstream Ltd, a business process outsourcing organisation wholly owned by ICICI Bank, India’s largest private financial services organisation.<ref name=":0">{{Cite news |title=Firstsource Solutions Ltd. |work=Business Standard India |url=https://www.business-standard.com/company/firstsour-solu-24882/information/company-history |access-date=2021-09-01 |archive-date=1 September 2021 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210901163950/https://www.business-standard.com/company/firstsour-solu-24882/information/company-history |url-status=live }}</ref> Company’s name was later changed to ICICI
OneSource Limited before it adopted its current name as Firstsource Solutions Limited in 2006.<ref>{{Cite news|title=Firstsource Prospectus 2007|work=First source Website|url=https://www.firstsource.com/sites/default/files/2024-11/FSL-prospectus.pdf|access-date=2026-01-29}}</ref> The same year, Firstsource opened a branch office in the Philippines.<ref name=":0" /> Firstsource made an [[initial public offer]] in 2007 and was listed on the National Stock Exchange (NSE)<ref>{{Cite web |title=Why Firstsource is Going Slim |url=https://www.forbes.com/2009/09/01/forbes-india-ananda-mukerji-icici-bank-firstsource.html |access-date=2024-05-07 |website=Forbes |language=en |archive-date=7 May 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240507015217/https://www.forbes.com/2009/09/01/forbes-india-ananda-mukerji-icici-bank-firstsource.html |url-status=live }}</ref> and Bombay Stock Exchange (BSE) in India on 22 February 2007.<ref>{{Cite web|title=Firstsource Solutions IPO Review - Firstsource Solutions IPO Dates, Issue Price, Subscription and Allotment Status|url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/firstsource-solutions-ltd/ipos/companyid-99.cms|access-date=2021-11-29|website=The Economic Times|archive-date=29 November 2021|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20211129172944/https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/firstsource-solutions-ltd/ipos/companyid-99.cms|url-status=live}}</ref>

=== Acquisitions ===
In 2002, the company acquired CustomerAsset and Tawny Dove Ltd. One year later, it acquired FirstRing India Pvt Ltd, a contact centre company. In 2005, it acquired healthcare services provider RevIT.<ref name=":0" /> In December 2006, it acquired Business Process Management Inc (BPM).<ref name=":0" /> Firstsource acquired ISGN in 2016, which was rebranded as Sourcepoint in 2019.<ref>{{cite web|title=ISGN Rebrands as Sourcepoint|url=https://nationalmortgageprofessional.com/news/70182/isgn-rebrands-sourcepoint|publisher=NationalMortgageProfessional.com|access-date=9 September 2019|archive-date=2 March 2019|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190302061506/https://nationalmortgageprofessional.com/news/70182/isgn-rebrands-sourcepoint|url-status=live}}</ref>

In November 2021, Firstsource announced to acquire the US mortgage services provider The StoneHill Group.<ref>{{Cite news|title=Firstsource Solutions transitioning from being a BPO player to a platform player: Sanjiv Goenka|work=The Economic Times|url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/markets/expert-view/firstsource-solutions-transitioning-from-being-a-bpo-player-to-a-platform-player-sanjiv-goenka/articleshow/87625117.cms?from=mdr|access-date=2021-11-29|archive-date=29 November 2021|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20211129175123/https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/markets/expert-view/firstsource-solutions-transitioning-from-being-a-bpo-player-to-a-platform-player-sanjiv-goenka/articleshow/87625117.cms?from=mdr|url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|title=Firstsource Solutions' step-down subsidiary Sourcepoint to acquire US-led The StoneHill Group|url=https://www.indiainfoline.com/article/news-top-story/firstsource-solutions-step-down-subsidiary-sourcepoint-to-acquire-us-led-the-stonehill-group-121111100576_1.html|access-date=2021-11-29|website=indiainfoline.com|language=en}}</ref> In May 2024, Firstsource acquired Chennai-based medical billing firm Quintessence Business Solutions & Services (QBSS) for ₹327.8 crore (approximately US$39 million). The acquisition included its US arm, Quintessence Health LLC, which became a step-down subsidiary.<ref name=qbss1>{{cite news |title=Firstsource Solutions to acquire medical billing firm QBSS for nearly $40 mn |publisher=VCCircle |date=3 May 2024 |url=https://www.vccircle.com/firstsource-solutions-to-acquire-medical-billing-firm-qbss-for-nearly-40-mn}}</ref><ref name=qbss2>{{cite news |title=Firstsource acquires medical billing firm QBSS for $40Mn |publisher=Outsource Accelerator |date=7 May 2024 |url=https://news.outsourceaccelerator.com/firstsource-medical-qbss-40mn/}}</ref>

In September 2024, Firstsource acquired UK-based customer experience provider Ascensos for £42 million (approximately US$56 million). Ascensos continues to operate independently as a business unit headquartered in Scotland.<ref name=ascensos1>{{cite news |title=Firstsource acquires UK-based Ascensos for $56 million |publisher=The Economic Times |date=23 September 2024 |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/tech/information-tech/firstsource-acquires-uk-based-ascensos-for-56-million/articleshow/113604886.cms |archive-date=12 June 2025 |access-date=12 June 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250612065034/https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/tech/information-tech/firstsource-acquires-uk-based-ascensos-for-56-million/articleshow/113604886.cms |url-status=live }}</ref>

== Corporate affairs ==

=== Operations ===
As of March 2025, Firstsource operates global delivery centers across 10 countries including India, the United States, the United Kingdom, the Philippines, South Africa, Australia, Mexico, Romania, Trinidad and Tobago, and Turkey.<ref name=":1">{{cite web |title=Firstsource Solutions Reports Fourth Quarter and Fiscal 2025 Results |url=https://www.firstsource.com/sites/default/files/2025-04/FSL-PressRelease-Q4FY25.pdf |website=Firstsource.com |date=April 30, 2025 |access-date=June 12, 2025 |archive-date=14 May 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250514060109/https://www.firstsource.com/sites/default/files/2025-04/FSL-PressRelease-Q4FY25.pdf |url-status=live }}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=Investor Presentation Q4 FY25 |url=https://www.firstsource.com/sites/default/files/2025-04/FSL-InvestorPresentation-Q4FY25.pdf |website=Firstsource.com |date=April 30, 2025 |access-date=June 12, 2025}}</ref> The company primarily serves clients in North America and Europe, with North America accounting for approximately 68% of revenues and [[EMEA]] for 31%.<ref>{{cite web |title=Investor Presentation Q4 FY25 |url=https://www.firstsource.com/sites/default/files/2025-04/FSL-InvestorPresentation-Q4FY25.pdf |website=Firstsource.com |date=April 30, 2025 |access-date=June 12, 2025 |archive-date=14 May 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250514042245/https://www.firstsource.com/sites/default/files/2025-04/FSL-InvestorPresentation-Q4FY25.pdf |url-status=live }}</ref>

=== Ownership ===
As of 31 March 2025, the [[Corporate promoter|promoter]] RPSG Ventures Limited owned a 53.66% stake in Firstsource. The rest is owned by [[Public float|public shareholders]] including mutual funds, domestic and foreign institutions, and retail investors.<ref>{{cite web |title=Shareholding Pattern as on March 31, 2025 |url=https://www.firstsource.com/sites/default/files/2025-04/Pie-digram-Q4FY-2024-25.pdf |publisher=Firstsource.com |date=April 2025 |access-date=June 12, 2025 |archive-date=19 April 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250419182423/https://www.firstsource.com/sites/default/files/2025-04/Pie-digram-Q4FY-2024-25.pdf |url-status=live }}</ref>
